_note: wording: BA review — English drafted with AI

natural.label: Natural
natural.desc: More natural, less blur. Works better with motion (uses real background from neighboring frames). If the preview is still smeared, switch to Crop.

crop.label: Crop
crop.desc: Cuts off the edge containing the logo — changes the video size, usually the cleanest when the logo is near the edge

blur.label: Blur
blur.desc: Blurs over the logo area — fast, but leaves a visible smudge

suitability.good: This case is suitable for automatic cleanup.
suitability.manual: Please confirm the logo area so we can process it more accurately.
suitability.crop: For this video, cropping the frame may give better results than pixel fill.
suitability.low: This area isn't suitable for automatic cleanup — you may see smudges.

synthIdNote: Only applies to logos visible on the frame. The invisible SynthID watermark is not supported and can't be removed by any tool.

duration.title: ⏱ Video too long
duration.pro: Video is {{seconds}}s long (Pro limit: 2 minutes). Please trim the video first.
duration.free: Video is {{seconds}}s long (free limit: 30 seconds). Upgrade to Pro or trim the video to a shorter length.

errors.unsupportedFormat: Only MP4, MOV, WebM and MKV are supported.

header.title: Visible logo cleanup
header.subtitle: For Flow/Veo videos with a logo visible on the frame. Not every video has one.

idle.drop: Drag and drop a video here or click to choose a file
idle.formats: MP4 · MOV · WebM · MKV · up to 500MB
idle.hint: Best for videos with a clearly visible logo on the frame · Clips < 2 minutes work best

uploading.title: Uploading video...
uploading.subtitle: Extracting a frame to locate the visible logo area

preview.cropHint: The bright area is what's kept after cropping — the dark area containing the logo will be removed. Change the corner below to change the crop.
preview.dragHint: Drag the orange box to move it · drag corners/edges to resize. Align it precisely with the visible logo.
preview.whichCorner: Which corner is the logo in?
preview.noLogo: I don't see a visible logo in this video
preview.methodTip: ⚡ Best for small logos on low-motion backgrounds. If the video is too long, trim it first.
preview.tryNatural: I still want to try natural removal instead

guidance.telea: · TELEA works best for small logos in a corner on a fairly clean background. Select a bit extra margin.
guidance.crop: · Crop is usually cleanest when the logo is near the edge — no smudge left on the background.
guidance.longClip: · This clip is long or complex — cropping may give a better result.
guidance.adjusted: · Area adjusted manually — check the preview before processing the whole video.
guidance.padding0: · Padding 0px — if you still see a blurry edge, try raising it to 8px.

noLogo.title: This video doesn't need logo cleanup
noLogo.body: No visible logo detected on the frame. If you still see one, try selecting the area manually.
noLogo.case1: · Google One Ultra — Flow on this plan usually doesn't include a visible logo
noLogo.case2: · Logo only for a few seconds — check the start or end of the clip, not just the first frame
noLogo.case3: · Exported from your own project — some export flows don't add a visible logo
noLogo.synthId: All Flow/Veo videos carry SynthID — an invisible watermark you can't see with the naked eye. SynthID is completely different from a visible logo and is not supported.
noLogo.manual: I still see a logo — select the area manually

frame.title: Result on the first frame
frame.subtitle: Check before processing the whole video
frame.error: Couldn't load the preview — you can still continue processing.
frame.loading: Generating a preview from the first frame…
frame.weakHint: If the preview is still smeared, switch to Crop.
frame.defaultReason: Works better with motion — uses real background from neighboring frames.
frame.tipBlur: · If you see a blurry edge — go back and increase padding or enlarge the selection.
frame.tipFirstFrame: · This is the first frame — the whole clip uses the same processing.

processing.title: Cleaning up the visible logo...
processing.natural: Rebuilding the background with patch texture + real background from neighboring frames
processing.crop: Calculating and cropping the edge containing the logo
processing.suffix: · 30–180 seconds depending on clip length & motion

done.lowConfidence: Processed from a low-confidence case — if you see smudges, try again with the Crop method.
done.variance: Results may vary depending on the logo size and the background behind the processed area.

error.title: We can't process this video yet
error.fallback: The logo area isn't suitable for automatic cleanup yet.
error.tip1: · Logo at a corner or edge → try the Crop method — more reliable on any background
error.tip2: · Complex background → Pixel fill may leave uneven marks; Crop or Blur will work better
error.tip3: · Clip > 2 minutes → trim to the part you need before processing
